Empowering People, Advancing Purpose, Delivering Performance
We cultivate tomorrow’s leaders by putting people first and helping our 60,000+ teammates belong, grow and thrive. We provide the space and tools for teammates to shape and become their advantage.

We keep our purpose close, committed to connecting people with products and experiences that enrich their lives. We have proud partnerships and investments in support of nutrition security, economic empowerment and well-being.
We serve as a strategic advisor and insight-driven problem-solver, providing custom solutions for companies of all sizes and in all phases of their journey.
Our purpose-driven leaders embrace their roles with enthusiasm, individuality and rigor, while serving with heart and leading with the people-first values that define Advantage Solutions.

Our Trusted Board of Directors

Our business growth strategies are overseen by our board of directors, a group of 14 industry leaders who are committed to providing strategic oversight to drive our business forward and keep commerce and life moving.
Empowering Our Community Through Inclusive Practices

We’re committed to building a workfo r ce that reflects the diversity of the world around us, with equitable opportunities for enrichment in an environment where everyone feels safe and knows they belo ng . Our commitment to expand ing our people-first impact extends beyond our business , which is why we enable our teammates to connect with the communities where they work and live through employee resource groups , volunteer activities and community partnerships .
Connecting Brands and Retailers Across Borders

From our shopper insights-driven sales and marketing services to our tech-enabled business solutions, we bring brands to life across North America and select international markets. Part of our efforts to continue pushing boundaries and redefining how commerce operates is through our connection with international brands, retailers and teammates. Our global teams offer a comprehensive range of strategic solutions, including industry-leading omnichannel experiential services such as digital and in-store product demos and sampling, which includes serving as Costco’s preferred in-house marketing company for warehouse clubs in 12 countries, as well as private-brand development powered by Daymon, reaching clients in over 40 countries. Our partners Smollan and Advantage Smollan work with consumer goods companies and retailers across Europe, Asia, Africa, South America and Oceania.
Are you looking to expand into international markets? Reach out!
Questions? Reach out to learn more about how you can shape your advantage by working with us.

pages.raw_title: Private Brand Development Services | Advantage Solutions
pages.raw_meta: Drive brand development with private brand solutions powered by Daymon. Create innovative products, strengthen your portfolio, and grow with retail expertise.
raw_blocks: for Manufacturers, Retailers & Brands
Expand Your Business to a Global Scale With the Leading Private Brand Agency

Drive loyalty, differentiation and sales with Advantage’s private brand solutions, powered by Daymon. Combining strong relationships through decades of partnerships with manufacturers, retailers and brands, we are the world’s No. 1 private brand company, delivering quality and value that command shoppers’ attention and convert them into buyers
Ready to partner with us or have questions. Reach out to our team today!
" * " indicates required fields
Get answers to the most commonly asked questions about our private brand solutions.
What markets and retailers do you support?

Daymon’s worldwide presence combined with regional models ensures we cover everything from international superstores to local markets. Our teams understand market dynamics to help you prioritize targets, increase sales and build long-term relationships.
We’re new to private brands – do we really need to play here?

Absolutely. Private brands are a valuable and growing industry, helping retailers drive margin and differentiation, broaden appeal across price points for consumers and boost loyalty and traffic. Private brands diversify sales and can reduce business costs by maximizing capacity.
How does your expertise in private brands translate to the rest of the market?

We understand retail, period. Our experience building brands gives us expertise across consumers, manufacturers and retailers to drive true loyalty and growth. We ensure you have the right team and resources to grow your business.
How would you work with my current internal retail team?

Advantage works alongside your existing teams to complement their skill sets, increase their capacity and layer in additional data and information they may not have today. We enable retailers to be more efficient by aligning our vast resources with your enterprise goals.
What type of business model do you use with your retail partners?

Advantage offers customizable models based on your business needs and structure. We partner with more than 100 retailers across the globe, all of which have a unique team and model specific to their business. Whether it’s brand development, sourcing, package design, pricing, quality assurance testing or marketing and promotion, our private brand solutions powered by Daymon are built to help you maximize sales.
Advantage Solutions is your one-stop shop for everything you need to grow, maintain and move your business forward.
Insights & Sales Growth Solutions
Creating custom, insight-driven business plans to help brands increase their return on investment through technology and real-time data.
Product, Aisle & Shelf Reinvention Solutions
Partnering with retailers and brands to unearth new product ideas and opportunities backed by data and insights.
Brand & Retail Execution Solutions
Strategically and efficiently managing the movement of products from merchandising set-up to in-store and online fulfillment.
Omnicommerce & Experiential Marketing Solutions
Bringing brands to life with distinct branding, effective promotions, exceptional shopping experiences, sampling and more.
